items.title: A central simple subalgebra makes the algebra a tensor product with its centralizer
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file brauer.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a simple central subalgebra of a finite central simple algebra, the algebra is the tensor product of the subalgebra with its centralizer (statement lines 783-789). The proof is a complete argument: the centralizer theorem gives equality of the dimensions of the algebra and of that tensor product (proof lines 791-792), and simplicity of the tensor product makes the natural multiplication map injective, so that equality of dimensions upgrades injectivity to an isomorphism (proof lines 793-796). The non-formal content is the upgrade from injectivity to isomorphism by dimension. The claim is H2.
